source_notes.clean_mapping: The observed loader defaults to clean_dir + clean_fileid_<fileid>.wav. spk1.scp is only used when train_clean_scp/valid_clean_scp are explicitly passed.
source_notes.filename_noise_tokens: Tokens are weak labels parsed from noisy filenames; mixed/unknown names remain uncertain and are not ground truth categories.
source_notes.noise_file_basename: noise1.scp basenames are noise_fileid_<id>.wav and are identifiers, not semantic noise categories.
source_notes.noise_mapping: noise1.scp is not consumed by WavePairsScp.__getitem__; no online noise mixing or SNR resampling is implemented there.
